name: Yang 2021 cemiplimab PopPK scenarios
description: Exact source checks plus deterministic 3 mg/kg Q2W and 350 mg Q3W PopPK regimen probes.

scenarios.name: Mean-covariate individual 3 mg/kg Q2W IV regimen
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Deterministic fixed-effect 30-minute infusion probe using the Table 3 model and the paper simulation covariates.

scenarios.name: Mean-covariate individual 350 mg Q3W IV regimen
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Deterministic fixed-effect 30-minute infusion probe for the approved fixed dose selected by the paper.

scenarios.name: Low body-weight fixed-dose probe
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Paper Table 4 shows higher fixed-dose exposure in Q1 body weight; this dynamic probe sets 50 kg body weight.

scenarios.name: High body-weight fixed-dose probe
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Paper Table 4 shows lower fixed-dose exposure in Q4 body weight; this dynamic probe sets 122.3 kg body weight.

scenarios.name: Mean-covariate individual 1 mg/kg Q2W IV regimen
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Figure 5 dose-panel source-limited dynamic probe.

scenarios.name: Mean-covariate individual 10 mg/kg Q2W IV regimen
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Figure 5 dose-panel source-limited dynamic probe.

scenarios.name: Mean-covariate individual 200 mg Q2W IV regimen
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Figure 5 dose-panel source-limited dynamic probe.

scenarios.name: Mean-covariate individual 3 mg/kg Q3W IV regimen
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. Figure 5 dose-panel source-limited dynamic probe.

scenarios.name: Supplementary Figure 1 clearance-time fixed-effect probe
scenarios.description: Individual latent serum PK with stated covariates; not the source population summary. No-dose probe exposing the Table 3 sigmoid time-varying clearance curve so it can be compared with the digitized Supplementary Figure 1 post hoc clearance traces.
